result.reason: The revision adds cyber/privacy coverage at the permitted USD 2M fallback and retains fallback E&O of USD 1M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. However, it does not require the CGL limits to be USD 1M per occurrence and USD 2M aggregate; the existing undifferentiated USD 1M limit could allow only a USD 1M aggregate. The cyber trigger is also broader than the playbook’s Customer Data trigger because it extends to any Confidential Information or access to Company systems. Unrelated commercial terms are otherwise preserved, and the added language is generally clear.
